cream-ground.purpose: Page background under the colour field.

caramel.purpose: Colour-field blob; changed-cell border in admin.

honey.purpose: Colour-field blob; sale tag; announcement link.

espresso.purpose: Primary text; Bag, Add, active nav/tab pills, announcement, toast.

deep-caramel.purpose: Primary purchase action, focus, links, sale price, done timeline steps.

swatch-fallback.purpose: Product tint when the photo cannot be sampled.

glass.purpose: Resting fill of every frosted panel.

glass-strong.purpose: Bag drawer, modal, summary, auth card, hero card.

white.purpose: Label on ink and caramel fills; solid glass fallback.

display.purpose: Hero, checkout and WhatsApp band headlines. Width 108%, balanced wrap, max about 12-13ch.

title.purpose: Legends, summary, panel, modal, bag and auth titles (18-26px).

body.purpose: Running text; lead copy at 18px in walnut.

label.purpose: Buttons (15px), nav pills, tabs, field labels. Sentence case.

price.purpose: Every money value; tabular, no wrap.

fine.purpose: Meta, hints, footer copy in taupe.

field.desktop: fixed, inset -10vmax, opacity 0.9: radial-gradient(34vmax at 10% 14%, blush), (30vmax at 74% 22%, rose), (30vmax at 96% 8%, caramel), (36vmax at 36% 60%, caramel), (34vmax at 86% 70%, blush), (34vmax at 6% 88%, sand), (22vmax at 56% 40%, honey), each fading to transparent at 60-64%
field.mobile: max-width 760px, inset 0: (70vw at 10% 8%, blush), (70vw at 95% 26%, rose), (80vw at 20% 58%, caramel), (80vw at 90% 84%, sand), (50vw at 60% 46%, honey)

swatch.method: 16x16 canvas downsample; skip pixels with lightness <0.12 or >0.92 or saturation <0.25; weight by saturation^4; circular mean hue
swatch.cardTint: radial-gradient(120% 60% at 50% 0%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--swatch) 42%, transparent), transparent 72%) over glass
swatch.counterTint: radial-gradient(120% 70% at 50% 0%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--swatch) 38%, transparent), transparent 75%) over glass

shadows.name: panel
shadows.purpose: All resting glass panels, paired with inset 0 1px 0 white highlight.

shadows.name: swatch-glow-rest
shadows.purpose: Product cards at rest on touch screens (hover: none).

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Focused inputs, selected payment option, current timeline step (5px).

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Single easing for all state transitions.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Colour, background, border and shadow changes on controls.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Nav pills hidden, hero card hidden, 2-column grid, head height 62px.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Deep caramel pill for the purchase path (Shop all, Pay, Place order).
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 22px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid transparent; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow .25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform .2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8a5f3c; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary { background: #8a5f3c; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -10px rgb(138 95 60 / 0.7), inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.25); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #714c2e; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 14px 30px -10px rgb(138 95 60 / 0.75), inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.25); }

components.name: Soft Button
components.description: Frosted white pill for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-soft { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 22px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.7); color: #2d2420; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.9); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px -6px rgb(90 60 40 / 0.25); font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform .2s; } .ds-btn-soft:hover { background: #fff; } .ds-btn-soft:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-soft:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8a5f3c; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Add Button
components.description: Espresso pill on product cards; turns caramel on hover, green when added.
components.css: .ds-add { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 999px; border: 0; background: #2d2420; color: #fff; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .2s, transform .2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-add:hover { background: #8a5f3c; } .ds-add:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-add:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8a5f3c; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Frosted white field, 14px radius, caramel focus halo.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field span { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 650; color: #57473d; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 50px; padding: 12px 16px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.82); color: #2d2420; border: 1px solid rgb(45 36 32 / 0.14); border-radius: 14px; font: inherit; font-size: 16px; transition: border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s, background-color .2s; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #6c5c51; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: 0; background: #fff; border-color: #8a5f3c; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(138 95 60 / 0.18); }

components.name: Top Bar
components.description: Floating glass pill with category pills and the espresso Bag pill.
components.html:
jlc

components.css: .ds-topbar { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 20px; height: 56px; padding: 0 10px 0 22px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.56); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(170%); backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(170%); border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.75); box-shadow: 0 18px 40px -18px rgb(90 60 40 / 0.28), 0 2px 6px -2px rgb(90 60 40 / 0.08), inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.9); font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #2d2420; } .ds-mark { font-size: 22px; } .ds-links { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; } .ds-link { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #57473d; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 999px; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color .2s, color .2s; } .ds-link:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.7); color: #2d2420; } .ds-link.is-active { background: #2d2420; color: #fff; } .ds-link:focus-visible, .ds-bag:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8a5f3c; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-bag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 42px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #2d2420; color: #fff; font: inherit; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-bag:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-count { min-width: 22px; height: 22px; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: #ebbcae; color: #2d2420; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; }

components.name: Product Card

components.css: .ds-pcard { width: 240px; display: grid; gap: 14px; padding: 10px 10px 16px; border-radius: 22px; background: radial-gradient(120% 60% at 50% 0%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--swatch, #e0b08a) 42%, transparent), transparent 72%), rgb(255 255 255 / 0.56); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(170%); backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(170%); border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.75); box-shadow: 0 18px 40px -18px rgb(90 60 40 / 0.28), 0 2px 6px -2px rgb(90 60 40 / 0.08), inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.9); font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #2d2420; transition: transform .45s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow .45s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-pcard:hover, .ds-pcard:focus-visible { outline: 0; transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: 0 30px 60px -26px color-mix(in srgb, var(--swatch, #e0b08a) 85%, transparent), inset 0 1px 0 #fff; } .ds-pcard-case { aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; border-radius: 16px; background: linear-gradient(160deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--swatch, #e0b08a) 55%, #fff), #fff); } .ds-pcard-body { display: grid; gap: 8px; padding: 0 6px; } .ds-pcard-body h3 { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3; margin: 0; } .ds-pcard-foot { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-price { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-sale { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: #edc890; color: #2d2420; }

narrative.overview:
JLC is a bright, modern phone-first shop seen through frosted glass. Behind every page sits one fixed, non-scrolling field of soft colour blobs (blush, rose, caramel, sand, honey) on a cream ground. Every surface the shopper touches (top bar, cards, bag drawer, checkout, notices, admin panels) is a white frosted panel laid over that field, so the warmth comes from what the glass refracts, not from painted surfaces. The products bring the only other colour: each product card samples the dominant vivid hue of its own photo and tints and glows in it.

The type is one family, Archivo, pushed wide (108% width) and heavy (780) with tight negative tracking for headings, and kept plain and sentence case everywhere else. Every control is a pill. Ink (espresso) carries navigation and the Add action; deep caramel is reserved for the primary purchase path and focus. Light theme only.

The world rejects the beige serif boutique and the dark luxury counter. The jlc script logo is a binding brand asset and appears as the ink raster (`public/brand/jlc-mark-ink.png`, `public/brand/jlc-wordmark-ink-lg.png`), never redrawn.
keyCharacteristics: Fixed warm colour field behind all pages; frosted white glass in front of it.
Product cards tinted and glowing in the colour sampled from their own photo.
Archivo Variable, wide and heavy for display, sentence case throughout.
Three radii (panel 22px, media 16px, input 14px); every control a pill.
Ink for navigation and Add, deep caramel for the primary action, honey and blush for small highlights.

rules.name: The Field-Behind-Glass Rule
rules.body: Warm colour lives in the fixed background field and in sampled product swatches. Panels are white glass; never paint a panel caramel or blush to add warmth.

rules.name: The Two Inks Rule
rules.body: Espresso is for navigation and adding; deep caramel is for paying and focus. Do not introduce a third action colour.

rules.name: The Own-Colour Rule
rules.body: A product card's tint and glow come only from its own photo's sampled swatch. Never assign card colours by hand or by category.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: No uppercase labels and no letter-spaced small caps anywhere. Weight and width carry hierarchy.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Prices, totals, counts and quantities always use tabular figures.

rules.name: The One Glass Recipe Rule
rules.body: Every surface uses the same glass recipe. A new panel joins the shared glass list; it does not invent its own blur, border or shadow.

rules.name: The Glow Is Earned Rule
rules.body: Coloured glow belongs to product cards only, in their own swatch. Other panels keep the neutral warm shadow.

dos: Do keep the fixed warm colour field behind every page, including admin, and put every surface on the shared glass recipe.
Do tint and glow product cards only from the colour sampled from their own photo, falling back to the caramel swatch.
Do use the jlc ink rasters for the logo; keep the mark at 42px in the top bar (34px on phones).
Do make every control a pill and keep panels 22px, media 16px, inputs 14px.
Do reserve deep caramel for the purchase path and focus; use espresso pills for navigation and Add.
Do set headings in Archivo at 108% width, weight 780, tight tracking, sentence case.
Do keep warm brown shadows and the white inner top highlight on glass.
Do honour reduced transparency (solid white) and reduced motion.
donts: Don't add a dark theme or dark surfaces beyond the espresso pills, announcement strip and toast.
Don't replace the warm beige, caramel and blush palette with saturated or cool colours.
Don't paint panels with field colours or assign product colours by hand.
Don't use serif display type, uppercase labels or letter-spaced small caps.
Don't use grey or hard offset shadows.
Don't redraw, recolour or replace the jlc logo.
